title: Grateful Dead Live at Jai-Alai Fronton on 1978-12-12
lineage: AUDMC played back on Nak Dragon> ART DI/O> Egosys Waveterminal 2496>

ai_review.summary: Good‑sounding audience tape of a strong South Florida show with a solid setlist.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this 1978 South Florida audience recording as surprisingly clear and full of energy, noting that the band delivers a solid performance with a good set list. The tape sounds decent even on modest speakers, making it a worthwhile download for fans of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments about the show’s energy and a surprisingly clear audience recording; no major flaws mentioned.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape is clearer than typical for 1978, with decent balance and no reported drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a solid set list and strong overall energy, characteristic of the Miami shows.
